name: TableSemantic
description: A simple semantic HTML table wrapper with consistent styling. Supports striped rows, hoverable rows, and three size presets (compact, default, spacious).

notes: Uses native HTML table elements for full semantic accessibility.
Wrap content in standard thead, tbody, tr, th, td elements.
Ensure th elements have appropriate scope attributes.
The component provides styling only — semantic structure is the consumer's responsibility.

children.description: Table content using native HTML table elements (thead, tbody, tr, th, td).

striped.description: When true, alternating rows receive a subtle background colour.

hoverable.description: When true, rows highlight on hover.

className.description: Additional CSS class names on the root table element.

do: Use striped for long tables to improve row scanning.
Use hoverable when rows represent selectable or navigable items.
Use size='compact' for dense data displays.
Use size='spacious' for tables with fewer rows that benefit from breathing room.
dont: Do not use TableSemantic for layout — it is strictly for tabular data.
Do not nest interactive components inside cells without testing keyboard accessibility.
Do not omit scope attributes on th elements.
